name: Sayonakidori no Uta
source:
"That day, I died---" 

There were rumors about the secret life of Yue, the taciturn teahouse owner. 
His reasons were noble......... 
Stealing only from the corrupt, and giving it to the needy. 

To protect himself he had one rule: never make friends. 
It was too dangerous to let anyone close. 
No matter the loneliness. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126447.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
“那天，我死了——” 

沉默寡言的茶馆老板岳的秘密生活一直有传闻。
他的理由是崇高的…… 
只从腐败者那里偷窃，然后送给有需要的人。

为了保护自己，他有一条规则：永远不要交朋友。
让任何人靠近太危险了。
不论寂寞。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126447.html]DLsite English[/url]]
